title: Call graph of one BC major (al-calls@1, D67)
description: data/code/graph/<major>/calls.json, written by the code pillar's `linked` stage (pipeline/code/callgraph.ts) from a graphify-al run on the snapshot checkout. Cross-object `calls` and `implements` edges between our object keys, aggregated per (source, target, kind). The allowlist is the content-policy guard (D10, CONTENT-NOTICE): object keys, kinds, counts and procedure names only; never a body, a line of text, a source location or a graphify label.

inputs.description: what the file was derived from (writeIfInputsChanged): projection version, snapshot and apps commits, graphify ref, scope, ignore template hash

commit.description: the W1 snapshot commit the graph was built at (data/code/<major>/w1/manifest.json)

apps.description: true: W1 app folders plus the first-party apps (src/Apps/W1/*/app); false: W1 only

s.description: source object key (type/id, or type/<lower-cased name>)

n.description: distinct (caller procedure, callee procedure) pairs; 1 for implements

items.description: "<caller procedure> → <callee procedure>"; (object) when the call lands on the object itself (Codeunit.Run, Page.Run)

unresolved.description: edges whose source or target could not be joined to an object key; the end that did resolve is kept
